arStrings.szText: {c_highlight}Úllo Sar death cultists{/c} can be found in {c_highlight}Helltides{/c} and {c_highlight}Nightmare Dungeons{/c}. Slay them to disrupt their {icon:Marker_Rupture_S14_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}rituals{/c}.

Slaying {c_highlight}Risen Enemies{/c} near an open {icon:Marker_Rupture_S14_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}Rupture{/c} will expand its {c_highlight}ritual circle{/c}. Defeat as many as possible before the Rupture collapses!

Disrupt {icon:Marker_Rupture_S14_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}Úllo Sar rituals{/c} and slay their summons to gain {c_highlight}Glints of Hope{/c}, redeemable at the {c_highlight}Church of Zarbinzet{/c} in Hawezar.

Earned through {c_highlight}Glints of Hope{/c}, {c_highlight}Pandemonium Fragments{/c} can be used in the {c_highlight}Horadric Cube{/c} to acquire {c:ff8158a9}Mythic Items{/c}. Pandemonium Fragments can also be found in Torment 1 and onward by slaying {c_highlight}Corrupted Reapers{/c}.

Seek out {icon:Marker_Rupture_Mid_S14_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}Surging Ruptures{/c} in {c_highlight}Helltides{/c} and achieve {c_highlight}mastery{/c} for a chance to face a {c_highlight}Realmwalker{/c}...and open a path to another realm.
A {c_highlight}shadow of death{/c} awaits in Torment Tier 1.
Beware {c_highlight}Awakened Exarchs{/c}! They will consume the souls of slain {c_highlight}Gravehounds{/c} and {c_highlight}Necrophages{/c}, growing all the more powerful.
Witnesses have reported seeing a {icon:Marker_Realm_Walker_S14_Season, 2.5} {c_highlight}Colossal Rupture{/c} southeast of Zarbinzet. Rumor has it a {c_highlight}Realmwalker{/c} lurks there.
Following the news of holy Akarat's death, despair has infected the people of Sanctuary. Show them there is reason to hope.
